about.companyTitle: Swift Safe Energy (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd.
about.companyDesc:
Swift Safe Energy (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd., a high-tech innovation enterprise spun off from Beijing Institute of Technology, was co-founded by an Academician-led research team alongside seasoned industry veterans. The company specializes in the R&D and commercialization of next-generation high-energy-density and high-safety advanced batteries.

Focusing on cutting-edge sectors such as the low-altitude economy, embodied AI, deep-space and deep-sea exploration, and high-end special equipment, Swift Safe Energy drives collaborative innovation across material systems, cell architecture, advanced manufacturing, and intelligent battery systems. By delivering battery technologies characterized by higher energy density, superior safety, and enhanced environmental adaptability, the company continuously pushes the performance and application boundaries of next-generation smart equipment. Its flagship products have been delivered in batches to leading market players in uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs), electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, robotics, and construction machinery.

hero.title: Command the wind. Fly further.
hero.subtitle: A one-stop high-energy-density power system built for low-altitude flight — breaking through extreme cold and heavy-payload limits.

painPoints.title: Industry challenges
items: Endurance ceilings are common — insufficient cell energy density and battery weight crowding out payload;
Vertical takeoff demands large burst discharge, with severe capacity loss in high/low temperature conditions;
Ordinary cells lose capacity fast below -20℃, failing polar and high-altitude operations;
Heat dissipation is poor at high discharge, raising safety risk and accelerating battery degradation;
A matched turnkey power solution is needed — the legacy fragmented supply chain (cell / PACK / BMS) carries high integration risk.

value.title: Solution value
value.desc: Lift endurance and payload within strict weight budgets while keeping power stable across takeoff, cruise and landing — even in harsh environments.

highlights.title: Differentiation
items: High energy density — more endurance and payload headroom at the same weight;
-40℃ ~ 60℃ wide temperature range — cold zone and high altitude ready;
Continuous / pulse high-current discharge — supports VTOL instantaneous power;
Aviation-tuned BMS — multi-series / multi-parallel networking, full-system adaptation and parameter tuning;
Cell + PACK two-stage thermal design — balancing energy density, safety and cycle life.

hero.title: Evolution, powered from within.
hero.subtitle: Lightweight, high-power systems that fuel every step of a robot's evolution.

painPoints.title: Industry challenges
items: Battery compartment is constrained; balancing runtime against battery weight is hard; weight shifts the robot's center of mass, weakening mobility and obstacle-crossing; non-standard cavities add structural-fit issues;
Walking, jumping and self-recovery create instantaneous pulse loads that ordinary cells and BMS can't match — voltage drop and false protections cause on-site mission interruptions;
Outdoor scenarios face vibration, shock and temperature swings; ordinary PACKs are unreliable — cold-weather runtime loss and high-temperature heating are common;
Generic BMS SOC estimation is inaccurate; remaining capacity reads are misleading, causing unexpected power loss and disturbing mission planning;
A matched turnkey power solution is needed — the legacy fragmented supply chain (cell / PACK / BMS) carries high integration risk.

value.title: Solution value
value.desc: Within tight volume and weight budgets, balance runtime with burst power, withstand shock on rough terrain, and extend continuous operation time.

highlights.title: Differentiation
items: High energy-density lightweight PACKs — control self-weight and extend runtime significantly;
Ultra-large instantaneous pulse discharge — handles running, jumping and fall-recovery power peaks;
Vibration- and shock-resistant structure — survives rough-terrain operation;
Robot-tuned BMS — CAN comms, seamless with host controller;
Dual-battery hot-swap — change packs without shutdown, keeping missions continuous;
-40℃ ~ 60℃ wide temperature range — indoor and outdoor scenarios.

items.applications: Inspection, security, exploration, emergency, supply transport
challenges: Runtime too short for missions
Voltage drop on running/jumping pulse peaks
Outdoor temperature swings degrade performance

configs.metric: +44% capacity at the same size, -2 kg weight
configs.note: 300A short pulse output for heavy-load running and obstacle-crossing; dual-battery redundant hot-swap; wide temperature support.

items.applications: Industrial operations, site inspection, public security, cultural-tourism performance, home companion, commercial service
challenges: Chest cavity is narrow — extremely sensitive to volume and weight
Gait changes create dynamic and violent power fluctuations

configs.metric: Optimised dynamic power response + precise SOC estimation
configs.note: Companion BMS integrates with the humanoid host controller.

hero.title: Reliable power for the deep blue frontier.
hero.subtitle: Salt-spray resistant and pressure-tolerant — custom PACK shapes and high energy density for the most constrained pressure hulls.

painPoints.title: Industry challenges
items: Pressure-hull compartments are constrained; battery weight directly affects buoyancy trim — endurance vs. lightweight is hard to balance;
Underwater equipment bears hydrostatic pressure; surface equipment lives in long-term salt-spray corrosion — ordinary PACKs lack sealing, anti-corrosion and pressure resistance;
Cold seawater temperatures reduce capacity; sealed compartments limit heat dissipation, raising thermal-control difficulty at high power;
Underwater retrieval and maintenance is costly — SOC/SOH accuracy and long-term reliability are critical; failure diagnosis is hard;
The industry lacks an integrated marine-rated power solution — fragmented cell/PACK/BMS suppliers mean long integration cycles.

value.title: Solution value
value.desc: Combine high energy density, salt-spray resistance and wide temperature range; support deep BMS customization; fit surface, shallow-water and mid/deep-sea scenarios; address hull fit, buoyancy trim and marine reliability.

highlights.title: Differentiation
items: High energy-density PACK — extend runtime, reduce weight, relieve buoyancy pressure;
Salt-spray resistant and shock-resistant packaging — withstands marine corrosion and bumps;
Wide-temperature-range cells — stable discharge output in cold seawater;
Marine-tuned BMS — compatible with underwater comms protocols, high-precision SOC/SOH estimation;
Custom-shaped PACK — flexible fit for constrained pressure-hull cavities.

Long autonomous cruise demands endurance and stability

configs.metric: Salt-spray proof + long endurance + remote state reporting
configs.note: Resists marine salt-spray corrosion; high energy-density design for long endurance; in-house BMS supports remote state reporting for at-sea monitoring.

configs.note: Supports thruster instantaneous high-power; compact PACK fits in tight hull cavity; wide-temperature cells secure low-temperature discharge.

challenges: Tetherless operation demands high energy density and endurance

Battery weight affects buoyancy trim

configs.note: Extends underwater autonomous endurance; BMS provides high-precision SOC/SOH to support mission planning; lightweight design reduces buoyancy-trim pressure.

hero.title: Rock-solid. Mission delivered.
hero.subtitle: Shock-resistant, vibration-proof, sub-second response at -40℃ — never offline when it matters.

painPoints.title: Industry challenges
items: Special-purpose equipment often operates in cold, hot, dusty and high-shock environments — ordinary batteries lose capacity and output in extreme cold;
Mission-critical equipment: battery failure means mission abort and possibly secondary safety incidents; reliability and safety protection are strict;
Construction, police and emergency-rescue equipment vary widely in form factor, installation space and voltage platform — standardization is hard;
Integrators need a turnkey power system, not bare cells; off-the-shelf BMS lacks scenario-specific adaptation;
Transient high-power pulse loads are common — ordinary cells and BMS aren't tuned for them, causing voltage drop and false protections.

value.title: Solution value
value.desc: Stable power under shock, vibration and wide-temperature extremes; supports non-standard sizes and voltages.

highlights.title: Differentiation
items: -40℃ ~ 60℃ wide temperature range — usable capacity at extreme cold;
Shock- and vibration-resistant reinforced PACK — survives job-site and disaster-site bumps;
Non-standard voltage and form-factor customization — fits diverse, constrained installation spaces;
Equipment-tuned BMS — tiered fault diagnosis and state reporting; integrates with host controller;
Cell + PACK + BMS coordinated safety protection — multiple safeguards for harsh conditions;
Rigorous bench validation — vibration, shock, wide-temperature and electrical safety tests.
